label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Pressing the Sale menu button gave no visible change in the tree, no submenu or expanded state, so I could not browse categories through the main navigation and used a link in the page body instead.
A link with untranslated text Translation missing: en.accessibility.skip_to_chatbot sits at the top of the page, which is confusing noise.

Each product card has a Quick buy button with no hint of which product it is for, and product link names are very long, mixing price and promo text; many items repeat the same name, so products are hard to tell apart.

After pressing Add to bag the button lost its name and became disabled with no announced success; the bag drawer appeared later and covered the Cart button so my click on Cart failed. The page also has many duplicate Add to bag buttons from outfit trays, so I had to guess which was the real one.

The Address field is a combobox with no listed options, card fields sit inside iframes, and a Remember me block with a pre-filled +44 phone field and Shop account terms sits right above the pay button, which is confusing.
